name: Throne Alerts
description: A Throne gift lands on your stream as an alert: who sent it and what it was worth, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. It shows inside every overlay you have in OBS. Installs the alert and connects Throne: paste the link this gives you into Throne's webhook settings, then send yourself a test delivery and watch it land.
changelog: First release: Throne alerts as a product of their own.
ready_message: Your Throne alert is built and listening for tips.
notes: A test delivery from Throne's webhook page travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake.
Once Throne is connected, its gift counter and latest gifter are controls of yours for any overlay you write: [[[c:throne:donations_received]]] and [[[c:throne:latest_donor_name]]].
